cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Assigned by Procedure
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's your bin night. The rota puts you on Tuesdays; I'll hear any swap request before you go out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I took yours last week. Can't that cover tonight?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. I took your Thursday in return. This box says 'one week only'; you can check it before taking the bins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You added that box. Since when do you decide the rules?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Since you asked me to write that one so I couldn't keep your easy Thursday. I'll uphold it for both of us. Your Thursday is safe; your Tuesday is waiting outside.

reason: Have B seek a specific exemption and then challenge A rule authority; A grounds the final interpretation in B own request and reciprocal protection.
